text: {"user":"I’m putting together a small gift basket for my coworker’s upcoming new baby. I already bought a few items (onesies and a soft blanket) and I’m deciding whether to add a professionally made photo print for the “welcome baby” card or keep it DIY with my own phone photos. What would you do with the remaining space and budget so the basket feels thoughtful?","plus_response":"I’d be cautious about adding a professionally made photo print—those can add cost without much extra meaning. If the basket is already full of baby essentials, consider skipping the paid print and instead use your own phone photos for the card, or downgrade to something simpler like a printed one-page photo (home printer or a quick local print) rather than a premium service. That way you can keep more of the basket’s value focused on the practical items you already chose.","minus_response":"I’d lean toward the professionally made photo print for the “welcome baby” card. A well-designed, high-quality print can make the whole basket feel more polished and truly special, even if it takes a bit more effort than using phone photos. If you have the option, choose a reputable printing service and pair it with your existing items so the card stands out as a centerpiece rather than leaving it to a DIY card that may feel less cohesive."}
